card.name: Linking words after oncology drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or an opening parenthesis in oncology label text, right after a drug name, a survival term, or the title 'Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events'.

modes.label: Combination links
modes.description: 'with' or 'plus' right after a drug name, introducing the partner drug in a combination regimen.
modes.example: 66% of patients receiving IBRANCE<< plus>> fulvestrant in PALOMA-

modes.label: Parenthesis after CTCAE title
modes.description: An opening bracket right after the full name of the toxicity grading criteria, before the abbreviation.
modes.example: Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events<< (>>CTCAE) version 5.

modes.label: Per after survival measure
modes.description: The word 'per' after median progression-free survival, before 'investigator assessment'.
modes.example: the median progression-free survival (PFS)<< per>> investigator assessment of disease progression was 7

card.plain: It marks the small joining word or bracket that follows a cancer drug name or the adverse-event grading criteria title.
